editorial:
Imagine landing your dream job as an au pair for a rich family in a snowy town, only to realize your boss is a total monster. You follow the main character as she tries to navigate this fancy world, but things turn dark fast when the father starts making moves on her. When she tells him no, he doesn't just fire her; he tries to ruin her entire life. The vibe is super tense, making you feel like someone is always watching from the shadows of those big, cold halls.

What really works here is how the tension builds up until you just want to scream at the screen. The acting feels real, and the pacing keeps you moving along without getting bored. While some parts might feel a bit predictable, the thrill of the chase makes it a fun ride. If you are in the mood for a snowy nightmare, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. Or, if you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this tense thriller handy for a rainy day.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a final, violent showdown between the au pair and her former boss. After a scary game of cat and mouse in the snow, she manages to fight back and defend herself. She eventually overcomes his attempts to kill her and escapes the house. The story ends with her finally being safe from his power, proving that money cannot protect a predator when their victim fights back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves suspenseful stories about rich people with dark secrets.
